import type { SnackbarMessage, SnackbarAction } from '@unofficial-krds/contracts';
import { KrdsElement } from '../base.js';
import { ExposureController } from '../../controllers/exposure-controller.js';
export declare class Snackbar extends KrdsElement {
    static properties: {
        message: {
            attribute: boolean;
        };
        action: {
            attribute: boolean;
        };
        durationMs: {
            attribute: boolean;
        };
        fallbackFocusId: {
            type: StringConstructor;
            attribute: string;
        };
        hovered: {
            state: boolean;
        };
        focused: {
            state: boolean;
        };
    };
    message: SnackbarMessage | null;
    action: SnackbarAction | undefined;
    durationMs: number | null;
    fallbackFocusId: string;
    private hovered;
    private focused;
    readonly exposure: ExposureController;
    private opener;
    private priorId;
    private hadFocusedControl;
    constructor();
    willUpdate(): void;
    updated(): void;
    private restoreFocus;
    private dismiss;
    disconnectedCallback(): void;
    render(): import("lit").TemplateResult<1>;
}
